主要内容: On July 1, 2020, the U.S. Department of the Treasury announced its intention to provide a $700 million loan to YRC Worldwide Inc. The loan was part of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act (CARES Act), and the Treasury had reached an agreement with YRC on June 30, 2020, to receive a 29.6% equity stake in the company. The decision was based on a certification by the Secretary of Defense that YRC is critical to maintaining national security. YRC provides 68% of less-than-truckload services to the Department of Defense and is a leading provider of critical military transportation and other hauling services to the U.S. government. The loan will help YRC maintain approximately 30,000 trucking jobs and continue to support essential military supply chain operations and the transport of industrial, commercial, and retail goods to more than 200,000 corporate customers across North America. The Treasury intends to provide loans totaling $700 million, maturing on September 30, 2024, and will receive shares totaling 29.6% of YRC’s common stock on a fully diluted basis, to be held in a voting trust. The agreement will also include provisions to maintain employment levels and limit executive compensation, dividends, and share repurchases.
